title: Cartoon Slip (Slide Whistle)
blurb: The cartoon slip — slide whistle down, bonk at the bottom. This is physical comedy's oldest audio grammar: the descending whistle promises a fall, the impact delivers it. Apply to real slips, metaphorical descents, and any graceful failure caught on camera. A century of animation tested this sound so you don't have to.
origin: The classic slide-whistle-and-impact of cartoon pratfalls.
